title: Talent Musica
tagline: The projects seeks to create an onchain music Dapp where young mujsic talents can upload their creation and mint it to the marketplace as Video NFTs.
description: The project seeks to create an on-chain music Dapp where young music talents can upload their creation and mint it to the marketplace as Video NFTs. If users like the music, such artists can be contacted on their Twitter handles. A young music artist records his song and connects his wallet to upload his song as an NFT. this gets displayed to the viewer, talent managers, and promoters. If your video is liked by them, you are connected via your Twitter handle.
how_its_made:
The project uses the Vite framework with react.js. Postcss and tailwindcss was used for the styling of the pages for the Frontend: Vite + react.js, 
The solidity programming language was used to write code that interacts with the Polygon Mumbai blockchain.  ethers.js was used to interact with the blockchain from the frontend. IPFS/filecoin was used to store assets, wallet integrations were coinbase wallet, Metamask, Wallet connect, LivePeer RMTS was used for live streaming live talents from the Dapp, Lit Protocol was used to encrypt and decrypt metadata details for Dapp, Zora API was used to collate NFTs.
